messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — PR #2874 (small routing fix) is review-ready but CI queue is ~45m right now. We have a deploy freeze starting Fri 00:00 UTC. Need eyes and a plan to avoid getting blocked by the freeze. @Priya any rebase windows left? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria: I can do a review in ~90m, maybe sooner if I wrap up docs. If CI still stuck after that we should either request a priority rerun or plan to land after freeze. :eyes:
Alex: CI backlog looks like it's the mac-e2e lane (lots of matrix jobs). Infra bumped ECR cache yesterday but cache warms slowly. One option: rebase onto main to pick up the cache bump — that usually drops job time by ~3-5m.
Dong: We have a 10:00-11:00 PST rebase window tomorrow that release engineering carved out for small patches. If PR can pass smoke locally we could rebase then and land into the canary slot.
ci-bot: build queued: pr-2874/sha-9a1b- mac-e2e (matrix x4) — estimated start 00:37 UTC. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/2874
Jen: If we can't make that window, I'm +1 for a canary flag rollout instead of full prod landing. Low-risk change, we could gate it behind a feature flag and avoid the freeze pressure.
Sam: Good idea on the flag. If Maria approves and Alex confirms rebase will pick up cache, we can target the 10-11 PST slot. Maria — can you post quick review checklist comments so we can clear blockers?
Maria: Done — left two tiny nits and one question about telemetry keys. None are blocking. I'll approve after the telemetry comment is clarified. :thumbsup:
Alex: I ran the smoke locally; steps are trivial: ``git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && ./scripts/smoke.sh``. The telemetry question is about including the new metric name — it's safe but will require a small rename in tests. I'll push a follow-up commit.
Sam: Awesome. @Priya can you reserve the 10:00 PST rebase slot for us and flag infra to consider a one-off priority run if queue stays hot? If infra won't bump priority, we'll plan the feature-flag canary instead.
Priya: Reserving 10:00-11:00 PST now. I'll ping infra to watch the queue and mark this as "small-patch" priority. No guarantees but they'll try to promote the job. Also filing a quick change to the rebase calendar: https://cal.redwood/internal/rebase-windows
Dong: If infra can't promote, we should document the fallback: 1) merge behind feature flag; 2) run canary control for 2 hours; 3) full rollout after freeze. That keeps us safe.
Sam: OK plan accepted. Maria — will you put the approval when Alex pushes the telemetry rename? If so I'll queue the rebase and update the PR description with the rebase window and fallback plan.
Maria: Yes I will. Alex — ping me in PR when you push and I’ll approve immediately.
Alex: Pushed telemetry rename and a tiny test fix. Noted in PR.
ci-bot: build started: pr-2874/sha-3b2c- mac-e2e matrix (4 jobs)
Maria: Approved.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll update the PR description with: "Target rebase 10:00 PST; fallback = feature flag canary if CI queue prevents landing before freeze" and tag @release-manager. Reopening if anything changes. :rocket:
